parts: [shouting] FUCK! [annoyed] This shopping cart has a wobbly wheel.
I try to go right... [frustrated] it goes fucking left.
So I roll it through the store... and it rolls right into some old ass lady.
[pained] She slapped the shit out of me. [whimpering] Ouch.
[angry] So I decide to take control of this fuck ass shopping cart.
[disbelief] But it doesn't like that. [shouting] It rams right into my ass. [screaming] FUCK!
[stunned] Now my ass is swollen to the size of a yoga ball... [pleased] I guess that's pretty cool.
[determined] I'm trying to control this haunted ass shopping cart...
[panicked] When it takes off through the aisles at fifty miles per fucking hour!
[screaming] I'm holding on for dear life!
[shouting] BOOM! [satisfied] It hits that old ass lady. [smug] She was a bitch anyway.
[relieved] The cart's fixed... [deadpan] but now my ass has a wobbly wheel.
